adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for collective team events, member destination calendars are accumulated into `teamDestinationCalendars` and appended via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op, so member calendars are silently dropped. This prevents `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` (which now only iterates when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`) from creating events in members' calendars for the case where only members have destination calendars.
